links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement of LLMs versus medical professionals in extracting SNOMED-coded information from ENT notes
links.effect: Cohen's Kappa 0.752 between medics versus 0.391 between LLMs and medics; non-inferiority of medic-LLM agreement rejected at all margins (0.05, 0.10, 0.15).
links.quote: Non-inferiority was rejected at all tested margins (  δ = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance and inter-rater reliability of multiple LLMs compared to clinicians for extracting SNOMED-coded clinical information from EHR notes, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
